description:
Make `jit validate --scope <container>` compute the one report over the whole repository, from the records the capture parsed, and call `ValidationReport::select(&Selection::Scope(..))` on it directly, deleting `validate_scope`.

## Background

- `validate_scope` (`crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:1833-1950`) reads storage and caches, fails on an unloadable rule set (`self.exec.effective_rules()?`, `:1843`), evaluates local rules on the bracket slice, evaluates graph rules with the slice as graph context (`evaluate_graph_scoped`, called at `:1915`, `crates/jit/src/validation/graph.rs:362-380`), and adds executor-side dangling-link and drift findings. Coverage candidates and dependency targets outside the slice are invisible to it.
- The validation capture holds no event-log history and no gate-run listing; only whole-repository validation and the repository-validation gate checker read those. `--scope <epic>` takes 1.86 s on a copy of this repository (1,863 issue files, release build).
- The out-of-scope container rule (ef0065ad) is asserted by `test_scope_skips_unrelated_breakdown_whose_container_is_out_of_scope` (`crates/jit/tests/cli_query_graph/scope_validation_tests.rs:800`).
- Tests that re-prove filtering: `scope_validation_tests.rs:531,587,659,800,864`. The external-plan tests (`:984-1215,1327,1356`) and the CLI exit and JSON tests (`:1456-1533`) stay.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `jit validate --scope <container>` calls `ValidationReport::select` for the container's scope directly on the report computed from one validation capture whose parsed records the report reads; no per-view wrapper remains (`validate_scope` is deleted); graph rules are evaluated over the whole repository, and the view reads no event-log history and no gate-run listing.
- [hard] REQ-02: Harness tests show that an issue outside the container's dependency closure carrying a coverage label for one of the container's criteria satisfies it in the scope report, and that an unloadable rule set yields the `rules-file` finding; each fails on today's code, which reports the criterion uncovered and returns a load error.
- [hard] REQ-03: A finding attributed to a container outside the scope stays out of the scope report, and the out-of-scope container test passes unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-04: The listed filtering tests are reduced to wiring or removed where the selection tests own the property; the external-plan and CLI tests pass unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-05: The selection property test (`crates/jit/src/validation/selection_proptests.rs`) generates images whose rule pass fails, and asserts that every non-Whole selection and explain fails with that error while Whole reports it as the structural failure (D-02).

## Decisions

- **D-01** — Steward ruling 2026-11-04: the CLI and the checkers call the one `ValidationReport::select(&Selection)` entry point (and `ValidationReport::explain`) directly, with no per-view wrapper function; the issue, rule and scope views share one executor function that captures once and computes the report without history, which 2c8c13b2 introduces and 86f7e6eb and 208edf4c reuse. Rejected: per-view wrappers (`run_rules`, `explain_rules`, `validate_scope`, `validate_rule`), four thin copies around one selection.
- **D-02** — Steward ruling 2026-11-04: `selection-membership` now reads "A report without parsed records, or whose rule pass failed, fails every selection but Whole with that error". The report is not selectable when its rule pass errs, so the scope view fails instead of reporting a clean selection over missing findings. The clause's owning case joins the selection property test landed by 728ecfb0 (REQ-05), since the issue that introduces a clause extends its owning test.

## Notes

- Behaviour change: scope rules see the whole repository, so coverage children and dependency targets outside the container's subtree count; an unloadable rule set is reported as the `rules-file` finding instead of an error.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Scope validation selects from the report
